newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Engen out of bunker mkt after unit problem.
newsitem.headline: Engen out of bunker mkt after unit problem.

text.p: Engen withdrew from the bunker market on Friday because of "wear and tear" problems at its Genref refinery in Durban but said it would continue to supply current commitments.
"We have experienced normal wear and tear problems in one of our crude units and have withdrawn from the market for new enquiries," a spokeswoman told Reuters.
She said the rest of the refinery was up and running and the problem with the crude unit "will be repaired as soon as possible. Running the refinery at full capacity is a top priority".
Dealers said that the "glitch" at Engen and continued high demand had pushed MFO prices to $110 to $111 from $105 to $108 earlier this week for what stocks were available.
